title: High technology business investment tax credit.
bodyText: The high technology business investment tax credit provided under section 235-110.9 shall be operative for this chapter on July 1, 1999.

annotations.heading: Revision Note
annotations.text: "July 1, 1999" substituted for "the effective date of this Act" pursuant to §23G-15.

bodyHtml:
§431:7-209  High technology business investment tax credit.  The high technology business investment tax credit provided under section 235-110.9 shall be operative for this chapter on July 1, 1999. [L 1999, c 178, §27; am L 2009, c 178, §7; am L 2017, c 3, §3]

 

Revision Note

 

  "July 1, 1999" substituted for "the effective date of this Act" pursuant to §23G-15.
